description: Use when an ARC shape encloses background cells; fill its interior.

# ARC outline cavity fill

For ARC grids with a colored outline on a background (demonstrated background: 6), recolor enclosed background cells to 4 while preserving outline and exterior cells.

## Procedure
1. Identify the dominant background and the outline color.
2. Use connectivity/topology, not just a bounding box: locate background cells enclosed by the outline.
3. Change only those enclosed cells to 4. Do not alter outline cells, exterior background, or open/non-enclosed regions.
4. Check for multiple interior cells and any appendages or protrusions that do not change the cavity.

## Demonstrated example
A color-8 shape encloses two background cells; both become 4. In the solved test, a large color-5 outline enclosed a 4-by-5 rectangle of background cells, all changed to 4; a protruding segment stayed unchanged.
